description: This file defines the 'Category' controller class for the OpenCart admin module extension. It handles the display and saving of configuration settings for the Category module, including rendering the configuration page and processing form submissions to update settings.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Category module settings in the OpenCart admin interface. It provides functions for displaying the settings page and saving configuration data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, builds breadcrumb navigation, passes data to the view, and outputs the configuration page for the Category module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST request to save the Category module settings, checking user permissions, updating settings in the database, and returning JSON response.
